Eagle Wireless

Junior Integration Developer - NetSuite

Junior Integration Developer - NetSuite

About Eagle Wireless

Eagle Wireless is building the connective tissue of the physical world.

Every connected car, every industrial sensor, every IoT device that needs to talk to the cloud reliably and securely — that’s where we come in. We design and deliver cellular modules and connectivity solutions that automotive, and IoT companies trust to work for years, in the field, without compromise.

Our teams span North America, Europe, and APAC, giving you the chance to collaborate with world-class engineers and go-to-market experts solving hard problems at global scale — from cybersecurity and supply chain resilience to regulatory compliance across dozens of markets.

If you want your work to matter in a world that’s rapidly connecting everything, and you want to do it alongside people obsessed with getting the hard stuff right, Eagle Wireless is where that happens. 

Job Summary:

Join our internal software team to connect our business systems with NetSuite, our ERP. You'll write code that moves data between NetSuite and the systems we use across manufacturing, operations, and fulfillment. NetSuite experience is not required. We're looking for someone who can learn a platform from its documentation and build reliable integrations with it.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

Build and maintain integrations between NetSuite and internal systems.
Read and work from NetSuite's API and platform documentation to design solutions.
Automate data flows such as orders, inventory, items, and financial records.
Work with stakeholders across operations, finance, and fulfillment to understand how data needs to move.
Troubleshoot and fix integration failures and data mismatches.
Document integrations so that others can support and extend them.

Qualifications/Skills/Knowledge:

0–2 years of experience, or a degree in computer science, computer engineering, information systems, or a related field.
Solid programming fundamentals.
Experience working with APIs, through coursework, projects, or work.
Ability to learn a new platform independently from its documentation.
Attention to detail when handling business and financial data.
Clear communication with non-technical colleagues.
Exposure to NetSuite or another ERP.
Understanding business processes such as order-to-cash, procurement, or inventory management.
Internship, co-op, or project experience integrating systems.

Our work environment is collaborative, and we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, which includes medical/dental/vision, generous PTO, and paid parental leave programs.

Eagle Wireless recognizes the importance of forming inclusive teams to foster an environment where creative solutions are made for our clients, and all have the opportunity to thrive and succeed. We encourage candidates from a variety of backgrounds to apply to be a part of our team.
